status: EXPERIMENTAL; locked before any new position extraction
position_rule: For lowercased rune sequence length R > 0, feature starting rune s belongs to region floor(4*s/R), in [0,3]. Every separator contributes to R. Word bigrams start at the first word; char windows crossing a boundary use their starting rune. No event is emitted for R=0.
local_features: same Unicode word unigrams/bigrams and contiguous lowercased char windows of lengths 2,3,4,5 as v2; bigram uses zero-byte separator
position_hash: FNV-1a offset 2166136261; process ASCII p, region byte 0..3, original feature prefix w/b/2/3/4/5, UTF-8 rune bytes, and optional zero-byte bigram separator/second token. index = 2048+(h % 1024), sign = -1 if h>>31 else +1.
normalization: Call actual base extractor and expose its float32 bits/order unchanged. Position bank alone uses the same signed log1p(|signed count|), float64 sum-of-squares over first-seen active bins, float32 reciprocal norm and float32 multiply; fixed bank scale 1. Do not renormalize concatenation.
implementation_reason: Actual public v2 API exposes sparse values and word count, not rune/event positions. Reparse the bounded input into an independent fixed rune array and enumerate the same local features for the append bank.
constraints: complete valid UTF-8 <=4096 bytes; no truncation; reject NUL as actual base
caller-owned workspaces; fixed arrays and sparse indices/values; no hot-loop maps, string allocations, locks, global mutation
no manual semantic labels, negation rules, label-selected features, model operations, training, weights, thresholds or existing-CLI edits
all six original pairs retained including any failures; no new reference generation or accuracy test
